proposal.summary: An information disclosure in GitLab EE (versions 16.2 < 16.2.5 and 16.3 < 16.3.1) allowed other Group Owners to view the Public Key for a Google Cloud Logging audit event streaming destination; the fix restricts Owners to writing the key only.
proposal.affected_product: GitLab EE versions 16.2 prior to 16.2.5, and 16.3 prior to 16.3.1
proposal.cwe_quote: allowed other Group Owners to see the Public Key for a Google Cloud Logging audit event streaming destination, if configured.

AV.quote: allowed other Group Owners to see the Public Key for a Google Cloud Logging audit event streaming destination, if configured.

PR.quote: allowed other Group Owners to see the Public Key for a Google Cloud Logging audit event streaming destination, if configured.

C.quote: allowed other Group Owners to see the Public Key for a Google Cloud Logging audit event streaming destination, if configured.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify whether any sensitive keys were exposed in affected instances and rotate any publicly visible keys; upgrade GitLab EE to 16.2.5, 16.3.1 or later.

evidence_quotes.quote: GitLab EE affecting all versions from 16.2 prior to 16.2.5, and 16.3 prior to 16.3.1
allowed other Group Owners to see the Public Key for a Google Cloud Logging audit event streaming destination, if configured.
Owners can now only write the key, not read it.
